Those scriptures were showing you it’s the leaders: a lot of these false leaders are leading our people the wrong way. These scriptures now show the impact when we prophesy; this is the proof of how powerful street teaching is, how powerful the classes are. You see what the Moynihan report said, you see what Deuteronomy 28 said: we are destroyed. But look what the Most High says he’s going to do.

“Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.”

precepts.why: What’s the marvelous work the Most High God is doing now? He’s repairing our people’s mind. As black men and Hispanic men are on the rise, repenting and acknowledging they are the Israelites, what’s going to happen? “So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous”: the salvation of blacks and Hispanics, and the destruction of the enemies: the destruction of America. As blacks and Latinos rise, America is going to come down.

sense.text:
Right now in the streets of Atlanta, hundreds of us, damn near a thousand, are teaching our people, showing them you’d better join this Israelite movement. It’s either you are an Israelite and acknowledge that, or you are going to die; there is no other option. And we want you to join us, because we’re going to teach you right; Israel United in Christ has set an excellent example.

“And the Lord shall guide thee continually”: the Lord will guide us continually if we stay true to his word, if we repent, if we stay humble. This is heavy. “And satisfy thy soul in drought”: he will satisfy our soul in drought. “And make fat thy bones”: he’s going to make fat our bones. “And thou shalt be like a watered garden”: we will be like a watered garden, “and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not”: whose understanding fails not.

“And they that shall be of thee”: the Israelites that are teaching, “shall build the old waste places”. We are building destroyed families. That’s why it’s important that you hit the streets, that we teach.

“Thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations”: we’re raising up the foundations of many generations now. You’ve got lesbian sisters saying, you know what, I’ve been wrong, I’ve been in wickedness my whole life, I’m joining. You’ve got homosexuals saying I’m joining. You’ve got drug dealers, murderers, brothers in gangs saying I’m changing my life and I’m joining. But the media will not show that. The media will say they are a hate group, they are teaching black people false, they are black militants. No: the army of God. This is what God wants.

“And thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach”: that’s what we want to be called. “The restorer of paths to dwell in”: that’s what we’re doing.

Paul gets deep on us here; write this down. Watch how Paul explains how we’re viewed by the world. If you think you repented as Israel and you’re going to receive love, you’ve been mistaken. You’d better get ready for the hate, get ready for your family to hate you, get ready for trials and tribulations. Your mother’s going to leave you, your father’s going to leave you; a lot of our mothers don’t believe. So you’ve got to separate. Get your mind right.

“We then, as workers together with him”: do you know that we’re working with Christ? We’re doing the work. We are damn near a thousand deep in Atlanta, probably past a thousand, to teach our people this is the way.

“That ye receive not the grace of God in vain.” You at home watching, don’t receive the grace of God in vain. What are you still so confused about? Repent, join us, keep the commandments. Don’t just sit there: ‘should I join, what do I do, I don’t know, I need a few more classes.’ You’re taking too long. You need to make up your mind.

“I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee”: in the day of salvation I’ve comforted you. “Behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.”

“Giving no offence in any thing”. Right now it’s the end days. America is about to be destroyed; we don’t know when, but it’s soon to come. So the Bible says now is the accepted time, and right now we can’t give offense in anything. Why? “That the ministry be not blamed”. If we give offense in something, whether adultery or fornication, they’re going to blame the whole movement. Sometimes we get weak; that’s why we’ve got to build each other up, call each other every day, strengthen each other. We get weak, but don’t give in. Hold on.

“But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses”. On your job they’re saying you’re part of that hate group. We may lose our jobs: ‘he’s part of that hate group, she’s part of that hate group, let me tell the manager, we’ve got to get you fired.’ Afflictions: how am I going to pay the bills if I get fired? What do I do? Hold on. Just hold on.

“By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned”. You see all those wicked Israelites that were with us, that little movement of what, 15, 18 brothers that left us: ‘I can’t join IUIC, they’re a hate group.’ They’re going to get their judgment. You watching online, you will get your judgment. You’re going to betray your own people? The Most High is going to jack you up, because you betrayed your own race, you betrayed your own people.
“By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left”.

“By honour and dishonour”: people honor us, and we get dishonor. “By evil report and good report”: people give an evil report about Israel United in Christ, but people also give a good report.

“As deceivers, and yet true”. People say they deceive everybody, they’re liars, they’re demons. On the comment board people are saying don’t listen to this guy, don’t listen to him, they’ve got a 501(c)(3). What is wrong with our people? Aren’t you trying to go home? What the hell is wrong with you? Why even join the chat? Get the hell off. People say we deceive the people, but yet we’re teaching the right message; people say IUIC are liars, but we’re teaching as it is written.

“As unknown, and yet well known”. People say, oh, I don’t know that group, I don’t know them, they’re so small. And yet the whole world knows Israel United in Christ: dignitaries, presidents, people of the highest esteem in other countries, best believe they know. But some people in their high positions cannot come out publicly and say I believe Israel United in Christ, and we understand that. We hope people like Karen Bass repent; she may be watching us every week online. We hope for more senators, some of our people, to repent. Some of them are secretly following us; that’s their trial.

“As dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed”.

“As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich”: making many rich, because we’re freeing the minds of the people. We’re liberating them through God’s laws. “As having nothing, and yet possessing all things.”

Jeremiah, when he was preaching and teaching, got opposition, the same opposition we get today. When Nebuchadnezzar came, Israel realized Jeremiah was right: ‘if only I would have listened.’ That is the same message to you: you are going to realize we are being used by the Most High.

“The secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is”. The judgments Jeremiah gave against the nations were fulfilled once, but the secrets of the Lord’s wisdom are double: what happened then is going to happen again. “Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.”

We are going to scratch the surface of prophecy. Towards the end of Jeremiah, Jeremiah gives a prophecy against Egypt, Tyrus, Edom, Damascus, and at the end Babylon gets the judgment. When he goes against Moab, Ammon, Tyre, Sidon and Damascus, that judgment was Nebuchadnezzar destroying those countries. But the secrets of wisdom are double: it is going to happen again.

“The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles”: against the nations.

“Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh–necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote”. We read about the battle of Carchemish already.
“Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.” Order the buckler and the shield and move close to the battle. That was prophecy against Egypt.

Now he is going against another country: “against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.” Remember the Philistines are the Africans. You have remnants of Israel in Africa, scattered all throughout, but then you actually have the Africans that are not our people.

This is against China. How can you say China is the next ruling empire when God has judgment written for China? You may say this judgment was completed in the time of Nebuchadnezzar. No: in Numbers 24 it says God is going to smite the four corners of Moab. Jeremiah 48 was a time they got smitten, but it is going to happen again.

“Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled”. Kiriathaim was one of the major cities of Moab: “Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.” When you read the chapter, he talks about the populous cities in Moab, and their religion, and all of them are going to be mourning.
“Concerning the Ammonites”: this is judgment to Japan. “Thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir?”
“Concerning Edom”: Edom’s judgment, because remember Edom helped the Babylonians destroy us. “Is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?”

“Concerning Damascus”: that is Syria. “They have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.”

You read country after country, all the judgments. Then finally Babylon, that was used to destroy all these countries, has its own judgment written.

Israel, pay attention; some of you are new at home. Remember the secrets of the Lord’s wisdom are double. This judgment is literally for Babylon, for Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians, yes, but when you listen to the words it is speaking about another place as well.

“Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind”. You may say that was the Persians and Medians. Okay, let’s go with that.
“And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.”

“Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow”: God says let the archer bend the bow. “And against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine”: the brigandine is the chain mail they use in war. “Spare ye not her young men”: God says don’t spare her young men. “Destroy ye utterly all her host”: kill all her host.
“Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.”

“For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin”. God is right in the judgment for Babylon, and he says, Israel, you have not been forsaken.

“Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul”. Your mind has to come out of America. You still think this is talking about Persia and the Medes destroying Babylon? No, this is talking about America. Pay attention and you are going to see this message is for you: get your mind out of America, because destruction is coming. “Be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.”
“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken”. All the nations have drunken of the wine of America, “therefore the nations are mad.”

“Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed”. You still think this is what Persia and the Medes did? Yes, that is what they did, but this is talking about America; watch and see. “Howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.”

“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed”. You can’t heal America; black man, you can’t heal America. That is God’s judgment: she is not healed. “Forsake her”: you better forsake America, “and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.”

“The Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it”. But the land of Babylon was not made empty. People still live there today; it is Iraq. “Because it is the vengeance of the Lord”.

“Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.”

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures”. Dwelling upon many waters means they rule over many countries. Babylon was an empire, but were they dwelling upon many waters? No. This is figurative, an allegory. America has eight hundred military bases; they dwell upon many countries, because they are watching. “Thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.”

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers”. What do caterpillars do? They suck all the nutrients out of the tree. That is what is going to happen here. All these other nations: remember it said the nations are mad. Terrorist activity will rise in America, thus saith the Lord. “And they shall lift up a shout against thee.”

precepts.why:
You may say to yourself, what if this is just talking about Persia and Media? The destruction of Babylon is compared to this: “As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.” Nobody is going to dwell there.

Do people live in Iraq? Yes. When the Persians and Medes overtook the land they didn’t empty the land. It wasn’t as if Sodom and Gomorrah was destroyed; that only happened once. God says there is going to be a destruction that is going to remind you of Sodom and Gomorrah a second time. That is talking about America.

“Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there”. America is going to be so completely destroyed and wasted that only the wild beasts will live here, like the movies, I Am Legend, all these movies that show post thermonuclear destruction: not even plants, just bushes.

“And the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever”. This can’t be talking about just Persia and the Medes; it says it shall be no more inhabited for ever, “neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.” Nobody will live there. So this is talking about America.
